calls.title: GrowthBook Issue Discussion
calls.summary: The discussion centered on several technical challenges, particularly with the Android SDK, including issues with configuration loading, caching, and feature flag updates impacting experiment accuracy and user experience. The team highlighted the limited visibility into monitoring config requests, complicating debugging processes, and noted gaps in experiment planning tools, such as the lack of a unified planning UI for tracking experiments. There was also a strong desire for better integration with third-party platforms like SuperWall and Customer IO to consolidate metrics. UX issues related to flickering on static cached pages were addressed, alongside feature requests for improved native support in the SDK. Participants committed to investigating various areas, including SDK behaviors and reducing flickering, emphasizing collaborative efforts to enhance product capabilities.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, SDK Caching, Experiment Management, Visual Editor, Third-Party Integration, Paywall Experiments
